description:
Returns the project's critical chain in date order, the near-critical tasks (the next ones to become critical), the slack distribution and missed deadlines.
A critical task has zero slack: each day of delay on it delays the project finish by a day. For the effect of one specific delay use planitude_delay_impact. Read-only.

nearThresholdDays.description: Slack threshold in working days for 'near-critical' tasks. Default 5.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

name: planitude_critical_path
title: Get critical path
